requirements.requirement: Establish that the described contest is an annual final of a prestigious programming contest in which teams of competitive programmers from universities around the world compete for a title.
Identify the particular year in which a team that included an Australian coder won the championship of that contest.
Identify the Australian coder who was a member of that championship-winning team.
Establish that the identified coder earned bronze, silver, gold, and another silver medal in four consecutive IOIs.
Establish that the identified coder's other two teammates on that championship-winning team were from the same country as the coder.
Identify the host university for the contest edition in the year that team won the championship title.
